description: Create one executor line (a member Session) for a task. Only the adviser's planning round and the secretary's request round may call it; executors, reviewers and scribes never can. The task must belong to your Goal's adopted plan. A suitable existing line is reused; under every-step confirmation it answers needs_decision, and pending while a creation is applied.

parameters.duty: Always executor; no other line kinds
parameters.scope: The member's scope; task arm only
parameters.scope.task: Task the new executor line owns
parameters.reason: Why a new line is needed; 1-2000 bytes
